diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/intel/libie/fwlog.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/intel/libie/fwlog.c
index 79020d990859..4d0c8370386b 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/intel/libie/fwlog.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/intel/libie/fwlog.c
@@ -1049,6 +1049,10 @@ void libie_fwlog_deinit(struct libie_fwlog *fwlog)
 {
 	int status;
 
+	/* if FW logging isn't supported it means no configuration was done */
+	if (!libie_fwlog_supported(fwlog))
+		return;
+
 	/* make sure FW logging is disabled to not put the FW in a weird state
 	 * for the next driver load
 	 */
-- 
2.34.1

The patch modifies a single file, `drivers/net/ethernet/intel/libie/fwlog.c`, to fix a bug where `libie_fwlog_deinit()` could be called even when firmware logging was never initialized, causing a kernel Oops. The fix adds an early return check using `libie_fwlog_supported(fwlog)` at the start of the function; if firmware logging is not supported, the function exits immediately without performing any deinitialization operations. This prevents the call trace that occurred during driver unload (e.g., `rmmod ixgbe`) in recovery mode.

**Relationships:** The modification is a single, self-contained safety check within `libie_fwlog_deinit()`. It ensures that the subsequent deinitialization steps (disabling FW logging, etc.) are only executed when the firmware log was actually configured, thus avoiding a NULL dereference or invalid access that caused the crash.

The libie_fwlog_deinit() function does not check if firmware logging is supported before proceeding with deinitialization, leading to a crash when called during driver unload without prior initialization.

Here is the patch:
  */
 void libie_fwlog_deinit(struct libie_fwlog *fwlog)
 {
 	int status;
 
+	/* if FW logging isn't supported it means no configuration was done */
+	if (!libie_fwlog_supported(fwlog))
+		return;
+
 	/* make sure FW logging is disabled to not put the FW in a weird state
 	 * for the next driver load
 	 */
 	fwlog->cfg.options &= ~LIBIE_FWLOG_OPTION_ARQ_ENA;
 	status = libie_fwlog_set(fwlog, &fwlog->cfg);
 	if (status)
 		dev_warn(&fwlog->pdev->dev, "Unable to turn off FW logging, status: %d\n",
 			 status);
 
 	kfree(fwlog->debugfs_modules);
 
 	fwlog->debugfs_modules = NULL;
 
 	status = libie_fwlog_unregister(fwlog);
 	if (status)
 		dev_warn(&fwlog->pdev->dev, "Unable to unregister FW logging, status: %d\n",
 			 status);
 
 	if (fwlog->ring.rings) {
 		libie_fwlog_free_ring_buffs(&fwlog->ring);
 		kfree(fwlog->ring.rings);
 	}
 }
 EXPORT_SYMBOL_GPL(libie_fwlog_deinit);
